question: What do you call a key on a computer keyboard that is used to move the pointer (cursor) around on the screen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Navigation key**__.

__
 
• **A navigation key is a key on a computer keyboard that is used to move the pointer (cursor) around on the screen**__.

 __
 
• Navigation Keys include the four Arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home, and End keys.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Numeric key**- It is used to put digits. It is located on the top, right-hand side of the keyboard.
 
• **Control key**- It is a modifier key. When pressed in conjunction with another key, performs a certain action.
 
• **Function key**- It is a key on a computer or terminal keyboard which can be programmed so as to cause an operating system command interpreter or application program to perform certain actions.
